ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

      SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
C1-5, Commercial, Manufacturing, and Employment District, symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 10-F in the area bound by:

       the alley next north of parallel to West Root Street; a line 194 feet east of and parallel to
       South Normal Avenue; West Root Street; and, a line 94 east of and parallel to South
       Normal Avenue

to those of a RS3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

       SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                             ___________________________
                                                             Nicole Lee
                                                             Alderwoman, 11th Ward




Common Address:
442-48 West Root Street
